comment: ANCHOR: PERF_HISTORY_TRUTH_20261106 — FU-007. A holdings row with asset_type null crashed the daily portfolio
pipeline at stage 1 from 2026-11-04, freezing performance_history.json; the per-account values it held were 2x
because compute_period_returns added holdings onto account_summaries in place; the Roth rendered UNCLASSIFIED
because the snapshot looked a raw-keyed state map up by canonical id. Synthetic fixtures only.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
